title: Effects of captivity and species on the cloacal microbiomes of an invasive and native anole
description: QIIME2 pipeline, R analysis and figure scripts, and sample metadata for Henry, Stelling & Lattin: cloacal microbiome of native green anoles (Anolis carolinensis) and invasive brown anoles (Anolis sagrei), sampled at capture and after two months in captivity. Raw 16S rRNA sequencing reads are in NCBI SRA under BioProject PRJNA1478682.
